UserPublicProfile.title: UserPublicProfile
UserPublicProfile.description: Minimal non-PII user identity record used as the parent anchor for user-owned subcollections.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the application header.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial profile creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

UserPrivateProfile.title: UserPrivateProfile
UserPrivateProfile.description: Strictly isolated PII document storing the verified Gmail address and login metadata.

email.description: Verified Gmail address from Firebase Auth.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last login sync.

PharmacyWorkspace.title: PharmacyWorkspace
PharmacyWorkspace.description: Cloud-synced pharmacy inventory workspace for an authenticated user (products, orders, Le Bon Danger entries).

serviceName.description: Department identifier (e.g. Service du Bloc Opératoire).

products.description: Bounded list of product stock records (max 500).

orders.description: Bounded list of pharmacy purchase orders (max 300).

bonDangerEntries.description: Bounded list of Fentanyl narcotic register entries (max 500).

bonDangerInitialized.description: Tracks whether Le Bon Danger initial state was configured.

customCategories.description: Bounded list of user-created custom product categories (max 100 strings, each max 100 chars).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last cloud sync.

/users/{userId}.description: Non-PII public profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated PII document (docId='info') storing verified Gmail address, accessible only by the owner.
